description:
Lists the items an export of a page kind would hold: the visible ones (all, or those with the given ids) and the linked certificates, access lists and DNS credentials they need, of the kinds the user can view. A user whose permission covers only their own items sees only those. secrets_allowed tells whether the user may include secrets (manage on every included kind). Errors carry a backup.error.<code> message id: invalid-types.

Needs: view on the section of the chosen kind (Proxy Hosts, Redirection Hosts, 404 Hosts, Streams, Access Lists or Certificates; DNS credentials use Certificates)

kind.description: The page kind to export; dead_hosts are the 404 hosts.

ids.description: The ids to export; leave it out for every item the user can see.

200.description: The items to export, the linked items they need and whether secrets are allowed

items.description: The items the export would hold: their id and the name they have in lists.

linked.description: The linked items they need, with the keys of the items that need them (needed_by, for example proxy_hosts:12).

secrets_allowed.description: Whether the user may export the secrets of these items
